project_info.title: Immersive tour through the fairy gate

prompt.main_subject: An adult martial-arts sister in a white-to-light-pink gradient gauze dress with flowing wide sleeves and pearl-and-diamond hairpins, leading a first-person tour through an ethereal ancient Chinese immortal-sect setting.
prompt.composition_elements: Six continuous 2.5-second shots total 15 seconds: corridor entrance, side-follow tour, courtyard stop, dance preparation, overhead spin, and close-up heart-gesture ending. Ancient eaves, corridors, peach blossoms, bluestone ground, mist, lanterns, flowing water, and distant mountain eaves form the environment.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft light, hairpin reflections, falling petals, pale-pink ethereal aura, star particles, flowing mist, and a fresh healing ancient aesthetic.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: 15 seconds as six shots of 2.5 seconds; use as narrative pacing, not an API duration parameter.
technical_specs.camera: First-person slow push, side follow, half-circle orbit, close push, slight overhead orbit, and close-up freeze.
technical_specs.motion: Smooth tour, gentle classical dance, one full spin, and heart gesture.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ethereal ancient Chinese style, fresh and sweet, first-person immersive follow, soft light and aesthetic. Use an adult martial-arts sister in a white-to-light-pink gradient gauze dress with flowing wide sleeves and pearl-and-diamond hairpins. Total narrative pacing is 15 seconds across six 2.5-second shots. Shot 1: first-person slow push at a corridor entrance; she turns, smiles, lifts a sleeve, taps the bluestone, and reaches out to invite the viewer to follow, with peach blossoms, mist, hairpin reflections, and petal particles. Shot 2: side-follow medium shot as she leads along the ancient corridor, brushes peach branches, and turns with a playful wink; her sleeves and hair move in the breeze. Shot 3: slow half-circle orbit in the courtyard as she stops, places hands behind her back, rises slightly on tiptoe, tilts her head, and smiles among stone furniture, mist, mountain eaves, and peach blossoms. Shot 4: close push as she raises her hands to her shoulders and unfolds sleeves into a classical dance starting pose. Shot 5: slight overhead orbit as she spins one full circle, opens her sleeves like petals, raises one hand, sweeps a sleeve over her head, makes a small tiptoe jump, and sends petals and pink light through the mist. Shot 6: close-up freeze as she faces the viewer, forms a small heart beside her cheeks, tilts her head, smiles, and ends gently. Preserve smooth high-definition motion and the healing atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, text, logo, distortion, deformation, disfigured face, stiff movements, camera shake, flicker, disproportionate, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
